profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Blackbuad
profile.summary: DevOps/Software engineer with a passion for learning and solving new challenges. Long time IT professional that has worn many hats across my career, always looking for a new problem to solve or task to automate. I love to build things or improve things, with a strong leaning towards automation.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a team that supports one of Blackbaud's many products, handling infrastructure and application deployment and development. I work closely with the application development team to ensure that code is deployed correctly, reliably, and quickly.

- Architected infrastructure environment in IaC repo utilizing Bicep for increased security and reduced environment drift
- Migrated VM based web services to Azure IaaS offerings
- Utilized Terraform to implement security infrastructure, working with cross functional teams to deploy the security infrastructure to multiple product teams
- Created account reset support portal with a .NET API and Angular front-end
- Deployed Azure Kubernetes clusters across multiple environments
- Implemented security improvements for Kubernetes cluster, including container scanning
- Optimized performance of API calls, leading to 4x performance improvement
- Migrated legacy services running on VMs to containers on Azure Kubernetes and to Azure Functions
- Implemented automation to auto-heal and auto-scale resources, preventing the need for human intervention and allowing the site to react to increased traffic or issues quickly
- Developed a repository of security and management related scripts for knowledge sharing across teams
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Terraform · Microsoft Azure · .NET Core · Scripting

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.locationName: Greenville, South Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description: Primary resource for all infrastructure for the company, responsible for all on-prem, co-located, and cloud resources.

positions.title: IT Project Engineer
positions.description:
Project Engineer handling infrastructure and cloud projects for clients in a variety of industries and configurations.

Handled projects such as server migrations, Office 365 tenant creation and deployment, Azure tenant administration and resource deployment, infrastructure and networking upgrades/replacements, advanced troubleshooting and more.

positions.title: Systems Specialist
positions.description: Systems specialist focusing on applications and integrations. Main responsibilities include general application administration, creation and maintenance of cross system integrations, identity management, SQL server optimization and monitoring, Active Directory Federated Services, and physical security system maintenance. As part of a larger team, I coordinated with co-workers on multiple systems and projects, including but not limited to ERP system issues, log analysis, utility script creation, and system configuration.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: Systems administrator for a multi-state manufacturing company. I managed infrastructure and systems across 4 campuses in 3 states. Main responsibilities included server management (physical and virtual), AD, DHCP/DNS, Exchange, SQL, backups, web servers (IIS, Apache, Tomcat), network storage, terminal services, networking, AIX/Redhat administration, including user management, ERP system performance, support scripting tasks using shell scripts, ERP system snapshot and dev/prod environment synchronization. Developed multiple web applications for internal and external customers, including creating an automated reporting framework.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: Internship that turned into a full-time position for a real estate management company. I handled systems administration and help desk tasks for the headquarters, as well as multiple residential management offices. My responsibilities included Active Directory management, DHCP/DNS, Exchange, SQL server, virtualization (Virtual Iron then VMWare), network storage management, backups, web servers (IIS on Windows/Apache on Ubuntu), and networking.
